map.title: where i've lived
map.text: born in inner mongolia; raised across beijing, chengdu and shanghai; came to hong kong for university and never really left. moving that often gave me a habit i'm grateful for: arrive curious, learn the local way of doing things, and find the people worth learning it from. hong kong is where i stopped counting cities. it is home now — and the place i want to keep building things for.
